To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
machine learning and deep learning algorithms are being increasingly adopted in sport specific movement analysis.
Machine and deep learning for sports movement recognition has been applied to a variety of sports and sporting movements.
Machine and deep learning methods have been used for sport specific movement detection and recognition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of machine and deep learning algorithms for movement recognition in sports.
the development of a novel machine learning model to predict the performance of a specific movement, in this case, a squat.
the application of machine and deep learning methods in sport specific movement recognition, and the associated challenges in model development and evaluation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the literature is currently not sufficient to provide a definitive statement on the best methods to use for the development and implementation of machine and deep learning models for the automated recognition of sport specific movement.
there is no single best method of model development or evaluation for movement recognition.
the use of machine and deep learning algorithms for sport specific movement analysis is in its early stages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the application of machine and deep learning to IMU and computer vision data for sport specific movement detection and recognition is a growing area of research with the potential to provide objective and reliable data for sport performance analysis.
machine and deep learning methods are effective in sport specific movement recognition.
the majority of research to date has used IMU data as an input for model development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of a machine learning algorithm to detect a movement is highly dependent on the characteristics of the movement.
the development and performance of a model for movement recognition should consider the nature of the targeted movement(s), the data input and the data processing methods.
the development and evaluation of models for the recognition of sport specific movement is highly variable.
